format: Interleaved float32 little endian; includes all priming and final padded frames.

cases.name: lc-mono-48
cases.decode_command: ffmpeg -v error -xerror -threads 1 -i lc-mono-48.ts -map 0:a:0 -c:a pcm_f32le -f f32le lc-mono-48.encoded-64k.f32le

cases.name: lc-stereo-44
cases.decode_command: ffmpeg -v error -xerror -threads 1 -i lc-stereo-44.ts -map 0:a:0 -c:a pcm_f32le -f f32le lc-stereo-44.encoded-128k.f32le

cases.name: lc-pns-48
cases.decode_command: ffmpeg -v error -xerror -threads 1 -i lc-pns-48.ts -map 0:a:0 -c:a pcm_f32le -f f32le lc-pns-48.encoded-192k.f32le

quantization: Per-band reconstruction-error allocation with exact DPCM, section and spectral bit counts.
quality_metric: Unweighted source SNR after removing 1024 priming samples and final padding; generated test inputs only.
